Satellite MisST (Microsatellite in-situ Space Technologies)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status cancelled
Organization NASA Ames Research Center
Institution Space agency
Entity Government (Civil / Military)
Headquarters US
Oneliner

Conducting automated biological experiments with fluidics system.
Description

Conducting automated biological experiments. The payload (two fused 10 cm cubes) includes an integrated fluidics system that maintains organism viability and supports growth and a fixed-focus imager with fluorescence and scattered-light imaging capabilities. The payload monitors temperature, pressure and relative humidity, and actively controls temperature.

Notes

Now SporeSat according to Gunter's Space Page.
